bagPolicy.summary: Small bags up to 12 × 6 × 12 inches are permitted after search; nonclear bags receive further inspection. Backpacks of any size are prohibited.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: The attached Warner Building Garage is entered from 12th Street between E and F Streets NW. Most standard tickets do not include parking; other neighborhood garages are also available.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: If you arrive by rideshare for Rooftop or 1924 Lounge early access, go to the corner of 13th and E Streets NW, the dedicated entry for those passes. Have your pass ready for verification.

concessions.summary: The theatre sells food and drinks at cashless concession stands. Outside food and beverages are prohibited.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: The operator publishes venue-specific accessibility information; contact staff for accessible seating and arrival assistance for the show.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: Re-entry is not allowed after leaving during the show.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Tickets are delivered for mobile entry. The box office opens on show days, typically three hours before the scheduled show, for ticket help.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Small bags are searched at entry and nonclear ones undergo extra inspection; the box office typically opens three hours before the show. Event pages give actual door times.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
